entities.summary: Hajji Hossein-Gholi Khan Noori (1849–1937), also known as Hajji Washington, was an Iranian politician, cabinet minister, and diplomat and belonged to one of the oldest aristocratic families in Iran - the Khajeh Nouris, tracing their history back to over one thousand years.
